# Redacting a share link on the product tour

The share step of the product tour, played twice: first as recorded, with the report link readable while the camera pulls back, then redacted. Sixteen timed mask boxes follow the link field as it moves, so it stays pixelated and blurred on every frame.

- Type: Redaction
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `mask`
- Output: 1920x1080, 8 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/f21-redact.mp4`](../videos/f21-redact.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> The product tour ../videos/02-product-demo.mp4 shows a live report link (hub.magnifito.demo/r/spring) in the Share report popover. Take the 4 seconds from 13.3 s, where Share report is clicked and the camera then eases back out, and redact the link field with a blur mask that follows it: one box while the popover is still (1316,347 to 1719,408 on screen), then a new box every 0.1 s during the camera move, worked out from the tour's camera path. For the client, play the original clip with an "Original" label, then the redacted clip labelled "Share link redacted", in Geist from fonts/.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f21-redact
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f21-redact/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 13.3 -t 4 -i ../videos/02-product-demo.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -crf 14 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p work/clip.mp4
mgvideo mask work/clip.mp4 --box 1316,347,403,61,1.15,2.1 --box 1316,346,404,62,2.1,2.2 --box 1316,342,406,66,2.2,2.3 --box 1320,337,405,68,2.3,2.4 --box 1327,330,402,70,2.4,2.5 --box 1334,322,400,74,2.5,2.6 --box 1346,313,393,75,2.6,2.7 --box 1359,304,385,75,2.7,2.8 --box 1374,295,376,74,2.8,2.9 --box 1395,286,359,69,2.9,3 --box 1410,277,350,68,3,3.1 --box 1423,271,340,65,3.1,3.2 --box 1435,268,330,60,3.2,3.3 --box 1444,266,322,56,3.3,3.4 --box 1450,266,316,52,3.4,3.5 --box 1453,266,313,50,3.5, --mode blur --out work/redacted.mp4
node rasterize.mjs label-original.svg work/label-original.png 1920 1080
node rasterize.mjs label-redacted.svg work/label-redacted.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -i work/clip.mp4 -i work/redacted.mp4 -i work/label-original.png -i work/label-redacted.png -filter_complex "[0:v][2:v]overlay=0:0[av];[1:v][3:v]overlay=0:0[bv];[av][bv]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/compare.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/compare.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
